GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
MAHABUBABAD DISTRICT
APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT UNDER PUBLIC HEALTH PROGRAMME
UNDER NATIONAL AYUSH MISSION (NAM), DEPARTMENT OF AYUSH, T.G.,
SECUNDERABAD
Outsourcing Basis – Mahabubabad District
Applications are invited for the post notified for Mahabubabad District. Candidates should use the form
corresponding to the post for which they are eligible and submit the required certificates/documents as prescribed in
the notification.
Name of the Post
No. of
persons
engaging in
Mahabubabad
District
Remuneration
AYUSH Medical Officer 4 Rs. 40,000 per month
Pharmacist 1 Rs. 15,000 per month
Psychosocial Counselor 1 Rs. 500 per session, at least 200 visits in a year (on
call)
Yoga Professional 1 Rs. 28,000 per month
Multi Purpose Worker (MPW) 3 Rs. 15,000 per month
Age / reservation / selection: The supplied guidelines prescribe minimum age 18 years and maximum age 44
years, reckoned as on 01/07/2026, with the stated relaxations; reservation is as per the applicable Telangana rules
and Presidential Order. Selection is based on the criteria specified in the notification.
Submission:
1. The applications will be received for the above said posts from Dt 22-10-2026 to Dt:29-10-2026 between
10:30 AM to 05:00 PM (on working days).
2. Applications are to be submitted in person or through Registered Post at O/o. District Collector and
Magistrate, Mahabubabad District.
3. The applications which are received after the due date (i.e., Dt: 29-10-2026 ), will be summarily rejected.
District Selection Committee is not responsible for the postal delays.
4. All the required certificates should be attested by a Gazetted Officer.
5. It should be written on the cover that “Application for the post AYUSH Medical Officer/ Pharmacist/
Psychosocial Councellor/ Yoga Professional/ Multi Purpose Worker under NAM, Dept. of AYUSH” Post
name which are not applicable should strike off.
6. For the detailed information please visit Mahabubabad District Website: mahabubabad.telangana.gov.in
